core_principles.description: Korean menswear favors wide trousers, wide-leg pants, and relaxed-fit bottoms as the standard — not the exception. The bottom is the dominant volume element.
core_principles.why_it_works: The wide silhouette creates an effortless, draped quality that reads as intentional and modern. It references Scandinavian minimalism filtered through Seoul's aesthetic.
core_principles.when_to_use: As the foundation of any Korean fashion outfit — smart casual to streetwear.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: When the top is also extremely voluminous — one volume zone must be restrained.
outfit_examples: Fitted white tee + wide slate gray trousers + white loafers
Cropped knit + wide beige linen trousers + suede loafers

core_principles.description: Crop the top to just above the waistband when wearing high-waist wide-leg trousers. The crop and the rise of the trouser must connect visually.
core_principles.why_it_works: When wide trousers have a high rise, a cropped or tucked top balances the mass below the waist. A long top on wide trousers buries the silhouette.
core_principles.when_to_use: Wide-leg trousers with high waistbands, high-rise wide jeans.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Low-rise or mid-rise trousers — standard length top is fine.
outfit_examples: Cropped mock-neck tee + wide pinstripe trousers + derby shoes
Half-tucked linen shirt + high-waist wide jeans + clean sneakers

core_principles.description: Build the outfit within a single color temperature — all warm (beige, cream, tan, camel, brown) or all cool (gray, slate, navy, off-white, stone). Avoid mixing warm and cool tones in Korean fashion.
core_principles.why_it_works: Tonal dressing creates a cohesive visual field. The Seoul aesthetic is rooted in quiet, refined color — clashing temperatures disrupt this quality.
core_principles.when_to_use: Korean smart casual, minimal Korean streetwear, any refined Korean look.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: When wearing a deliberate accent or color contrast — must be done with intention.
outfit_examples: Cream shirt + tan wide trousers + ivory sneakers + camel tote (all warm)
Slate gray overshirt + charcoal wide pants + white sneakers (all cool)

core_principles.description: Korean fashion uses desaturated, muted versions of colors — dusty rose instead of hot pink, sage instead of lime green, slate blue instead of royal blue.
core_principles.why_it_works: Muted tones reduce visual aggression and create a refined, contemplative mood. They also photograph beautifully, which influences the Seoul fashion visual culture.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: When you want streetwear energy or color-block statements — those require saturated tones.
outfit_examples: Dusty rose crewneck + stone gray wide trousers + off-white sneakers
Sage green linen shirt + cream wide pants + tan suede shoes

core_principles.description: Layers in Korean fashion are clean and uncluttered. An overshirt over a plain tee, or a structured jacket over a thin knit — never more than two visible layers.
core_principles.why_it_works: Korean minimalism is about restraint. Every layer must earn its place. More than two visible layers begins to look busy against the clean silhouette standard.
core_principles.when_to_use: Spring, autumn, and winter Korean outfits.
outfit_examples: Thin cream turtleneck + wide gray trousers + oversized structured coat on top
Plain white tee + open boxy overshirt + wide tan trousers

core_principles.description: The overshirt (a shirt worn fully open or half-open as a light jacket) is a core Korean casual layering piece. It should be at least one size up from your fitted size.
core_principles.why_it_works: The relaxed overshirt gives volume at the top without the bulk of a jacket. It's versatile across seasons and elevates a plain tee to a styled look.
core_principles.when_to_use: Spring, summer, and autumn Korean smart casual.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Cold winter — needs a proper jacket. Also avoid if trousers are very wide — competing volumes.
outfit_examples: White tee + olive linen overshirt (open) + wide cream trousers + white sneakers
Gray tee + beige cotton overshirt (half-buttoned) + slate gray wide pants

core_principles.description: Knitwear in Korean fashion uses fine gauge, soft textures (cotton, linen blend, lightweight wool) and boxy or slightly oversized fits. Chunky fisherman knits are not part of the Korean aesthetic.
core_principles.why_it_works: Fine-gauge knitwear drapes softly and maintains the minimal silhouette. Chunky knits add too much visual weight for the clean Korean proportions.
core_principles.when_to_use: Autumn and winter Korean outfits. Spring with lighter gauges.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Heavy chunky knits disrupt the silhouette.
outfit_examples: Cream fine-gauge crewneck knit + wide beige trousers + loafers
Dusty blue boxy knit + straight-leg gray jeans + white low sneakers

core_principles.description: Cropped jackets (ending above the hip) require wide or relaxed-fit trousers below to balance the shortened torso.
core_principles.why_it_works: A cropped jacket visually shortens the torso. Wide trousers below redistribute mass downward, re-balancing the overall silhouette.
core_principles.when_to_use: Whenever wearing cropped outerwear in a Korean fashion context.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: With slim or skinny trousers — the silhouette becomes top-heavy and imbalanced.
outfit_examples: Cropped structured jacket + wide charcoal trousers + white derby shoes
Cropped black bomber + wide-leg stone pants + minimalist sneakers

core_principles.description: The core Korean smart casual structure: one textured or tonal top + wide relaxed trousers + clean minimalist footwear. No excess accessories.
core_principles.why_it_works: This formula is deliberately simple and proportionally precise — it communicates effortless taste without over-explaining itself.
core_principles.when_to_use: Office, date night, casual dinner, Seoul-inspired outfits.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: When you need formal or evening wear — this stays in the smart-casual register.
outfit_examples: Beige linen shirt + wide cream trousers + tan suede loafers
White mock-neck + wide dark navy pants + clean white sneakers

core_principles.description: Korean fashion footwear is clean, minimal, and low-profile: clean white sneakers, minimalist leather sneakers, loafers, simple derby shoes. Avoid chunky streetwear sneakers in Korean minimal contexts.
core_principles.why_it_works: Chunky soles fight the quiet quality of the Korean silhouette. Low-profile shoes allow the wide trouser silhouette to land cleanly at the ground.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Korean streetwear contexts can allow chunky soles as an intentional contrast.
outfit_examples: Wide gray trousers + white Common Projects Achilles sneakers
Wide linen trousers + suede penny loafers

core_principles.description: Korean fashion uses minimal accessories — one bag, one subtle piece of jewelry, no hat unless it is architecturally minimal (bucket hat, minimal cap). No heavy accessory stacking.
core_principles.why_it_works: Accessories compete with the silhouette in Korean fashion. The silhouette IS the statement — accessories support, not compete.
core_principles.when_to_avoid: Korean streetwear can layer accessories for a different effect.
outfit_examples: Clean outfit + single minimal crossbody bag + no other accessories
Wide-leg trouser outfit + small tote bag + no cap, no jewelry

outfit_formulas.formula: Overshirt (Open) + Plain Tee + Wide Trousers + Clean White Sneakers
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: The open overshirt creates a layered look without bulk. Wide trousers are the silhouette focus. Clean sneakers ground it all.

outfit_formulas.formula: Fine-Gauge Boxy Knit + Wide Relaxed Slacks + Suede Loafers
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Knit softens the top. Wide slacks create elegant volume below. Suede loafers add tactile refinement. Entirely tonal.

outfit_formulas.formula: Cropped Structured Jacket + Wide Charcoal Trousers + Derby Shoes
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Cropped jacket + wide trouser is the defining Korean fashion proportion. Derby shoes elevate the register without breaking the minimalism.

outfit_formulas.formula: Cream Turtleneck + Wide Beige Trousers + Minimal White Sneakers
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Full warm-tonal outfit. Turtleneck adds structure to the neckline. Wide trousers are the volume zone. Sneakers keep it casual.

outfit_formulas.formula: Linen Shirt (Half-Tucked) + High-Rise Wide Jeans + Clean Sneakers
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Half-tuck is the Korean smart-casual gesture — not fully formal, not fully casual. Wide jeans with a high rise are the silhouette anchor.

outfit_formulas.formula: Mock-Neck Tee + Wide Pinstripe Trousers + White Low Sneakers
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Mock-neck elevates the plain tee. Pinstripe trousers introduce subtle pattern within the tonal palette. White sneakers keep the ground clean.

outfit_formulas.formula: Oversized Structured Coat + Minimal Tee + Wide Straight Trousers + Sneakers
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: The oversized coat is the single statement. Everything beneath is deliberately minimal. The wide trouser provides the silhouette continuation below the coat.

outfit_formulas.formula: Dusty Blue Boxy Knit + Straight-Leg Gray Jeans + White Low Sneakers
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Muted blue and gray are tonal cool companions. The boxy knit reads as deliberate. Straight jeans avoid the complexity of wide while still feeling modern.

outfit_formulas.formula: Sage Green Linen Shirt + Cream Wide Pants + Tan Suede Shoes
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Sage and cream are complementary muted tones in the same temperature range. Linen adds texture without weight. Suede shoes warm the base.

outfit_formulas.formula: Beige Oversized Coat + Charcoal Turtleneck + Wide Dark Gray Trousers + White Sneakers
outfit_formulas.why_it_works: Warm-tone coat over cool-tone inner layers creates subtle contrast while staying tonal. Wide trousers continue the volumetric language of the coat.
